td_rows.title: Write sites: ON CONFLICT targets on chunks, INSERT column lists, writers of the three referencing tables
td_rows.new_form: Rewritten: the conflict target becomes the four-column PK (tenant_id, collection, chash, embedding_model) and the INSERT supplies embedding_model. Writers of catalog_document_chunks, topic_assignments and chunk_orphaned_at supply embedding_model. chunk_orphaned_at keeps its own three-column arbiter. Functions are redefined once, at migration step 7.8, against the swapped table (the LATEST live body, see live_in).

td_rows.title: stamp_chunks_on_manifest_delete / _update (vectors-021-3) and the manifest triggers
td_rows.new_form: Rewritten to carry embedding_model from the manifest row and to join chunks on all four columns; redefined at step 7.8.
td_rows.fallback_form: Unchanged; the triggers keep their current text.

td_rows.title: Views over chunks: live_chunks, collection_vector_stats (vectors-019), diag_chash_conformance (taxonomy-011-8)
td_rows.new_form: Dropped before the swap (step 7.1) and recreated over the new table in the same transaction (7.7); they bind by OID and would otherwise follow the retired table. diag_chash_conformance may be owned by a superuser, so its drop and recreate runs as that owner or is a documented operator step.
td_rows.fallback_form: Same: dropped before the swap and recreated after it.

td_rows.title: RLS: chunks_gate_probe_owner_read (vectors-029), tenant_isolation policy, FORCE RLS
td_rows.new_form: On the parent chunks AND on every model partition and leaf (PostgreSQL inherits neither RLS state nor policies, and a leaf can be queried directly). FORCE restored on every table at step 7.7.
td_rows.fallback_form: On the parent and on every tenant leaf; same reasoning.

td_rows.title: Constraints and indexes on chunks: chunks_content_retention_consistent, chunks_chash_octet_check, idx_chunks_tenant_chash, HNSW / GIN / trigram
td_rows.new_form: Declared on the parent so every leaf inherits them. On the retired table, indexes and index-backed constraints (PK, UNIQUE) are renamed with a _retired_225 suffix before the swap (those names are schema-wide). CHECK and FK names are per table and need no rename.
td_rows.fallback_form: Declared on the parent so every tenant leaf inherits them; same retired-table renames.

td_rows.title: Grants on nexus.chunks (grants-nexus-svc.xml, grants-nexus-diag.xml; runAlways)
td_rows.new_form: Re-issued on the new parent (runAlways, so they re-run on every walk). New leaves receive the same grants as the parent, including MAINTAIN for the purge VACUUM.
td_rows.fallback_form: Same.

td_rows.title: Isolation checks: ChunksIsolationCheck.verifyAtStartup (Main.java:131), doctor RLS canary _RLS_TENANT_TABLES (health.py:3408)
td_rows.new_form: Extended to assert FORCE RLS and the policy on every model partition and leaf.
td_rows.fallback_form: Extended to assert FORCE RLS and the policy on every tenant leaf.

td_rows.title: taxonomy_centroids (taxonomy-007) and its upsert (TaxonomyCentroidRepository.java:124)
td_rows.new_form: Gains embedding_model; partitioned the same way (model, then tenant). The upsert's conflict target includes the model. A centroid whose dimension changes (nexus-2qryr) is deleted and re-inserted, not upserted (an upsert cannot move a row across partitions).
td_rows.fallback_form: LIST-partitioned by tenant_id only; PK and upsert unchanged.

td_rows.title: Dimension CHECK: exactly_one_embedding on chunks and taxonomy_centroids (Technical Design, Model key, Dimension CHECK)
td_rows.new_form: Each model partition carries a CHECK that its model's vector column is the only non-null one (for example embedding_1024 IS NOT NULL AND embedding_768 IS NULL AND embedding_384 IS NULL). The parent's exactly-one-of-three CHECK is replaced per partition. Disputed collections are re-registered under a placeholder model (migration step 2b) so the CHECK never wedges the walk.
td_rows.fallback_form: No dimension CHECK per partition; the existing exactly-one-of-three CHECK stays.

td_rows.title: Primary keys and UNIQUE constraints on chunks and its referencing tables (Technical Design, Keys)
td_rows.new_form: chunks: PK becomes (tenant_id, collection, chash, embedding_model) because a partitioned table's PK must include its partition keys; (tenant_id, collection, chash) still identifies one chunk because a collection has one model. The referencing tables' PKs and UNIQUEs do not change.
td_rows.fallback_form: chunks keeps its three-column PK, which already includes the partition key tenant_id.

td_rows.title: Read path: search function families and the engine callers (Technical Design, Read path)
td_rows.new_form: Per-dimension function bodies keep their shape and gain `embedding_model = $model AND tenant_id = $tenant` predicates so force_custom_plan prunes to one leaf at plan time; RLS kept. The engine passes the model it already resolves through CollectionRegistry. hybrid_search_<dim> has no caller and is left as is.
td_rows.fallback_form: The read path adds only the tenant_id predicate.

td_rows.title: Router probe probeSelectedRows (nexus-tu8wp.6, Technical Design, Read path)
td_rows.new_form: Adds the same embedding_model and tenant_id predicates as the search functions.
td_rows.fallback_form: Adds only the tenant_id predicate.

td_rows.title: Collection rename: canonical branch and cross-model COPY branch (Technical Design, Write path)
td_rows.new_form: Canonical: insert the new registry row, then UPDATE the children's collection; model and tenant are unchanged so the UPDATE stays in the leaf and the manifest follows by ON UPDATE CASCADE. Cross-model COPY branch (CatalogRepository ~9096-9104): the explicit manifest UPDATE also sets embedding_model to the target collection's model.
td_rows.fallback_form: Unchanged.

td_rows.title: Quarantine: reaper_quarantine_chunks and the quarantine / restore functions (vectors-024; Technical Design, Write path)
td_rows.new_form: DELETE ... RETURNING into INSERT registers the quarantine sibling with the origin's model so the row stays in its model partition; the INSERT is among the rewritten write sites.
td_rows.fallback_form: Unchanged.

td_rows.title: Referencing tables: catalog_document_chunks, topic_assignments, chunk_orphaned_at (Technical Design, Keys)
td_rows.new_form: Every table that references a chunk gains embedding_model text NOT NULL, written by the same code that writes its collection (nullable, backfill, then SET NOT NULL at step 4; NOT NULL because the FKs are MATCH SIMPLE). Their indexes, constraints, triggers, policies and grants other than the chunk FKs are unaffected by the key change unless a row below says so.
td_rows.fallback_form: No embedding_model column is added.

td_rows.title: NOT in the RDR table: reference that needs no rewrite for the key change (reads, DELETEs, UPDATEs by key, typed field references) in a live function, view or Java method
td_rows.new_form: No rewrite is forced by the key change: a three-column join to the new parent stays valid. P1.3 decides per site whether to add the embedding_model / tenant_id predicates for pruning. Not named by the RDR table.
td_rows.fallback_form: Unchanged.

td_rows.title: NOT in the RDR table: DimTables, the typed accessor and name authority for every typed write site
td_rows.new_form: ChunkTable / CentroidTable (and CHUNKS_TABLE_NAME / CENTROIDS_TABLE_NAME) are the single authority every typed jOOQ write goes through (DimTables javadoc). They must carry embedding_model for the typed channel, or the typed writers cannot supply it. The RDR table names only the raw-SQL sites (PgVectorRepository:1168, TaxonomyCentroidRepository:124). Generated jOOQ classes (Tables.CHUNKS and the record classes) change with the schema; the jOOQ record-count guard moves.
td_rows.fallback_form: Unchanged: no new column; the accessors keep their shape.

td_rows.title: NOT in the RDR table: Java registries that list the tables by name (COLLECTION_SCOPED_TABLES, TenantScope VACUUM_ALLOWED_TABLES / PURGE_VACUUM_TABLES, VERIFY_RELATIONS, pg_catalog lookups by name)

COLLECTION_SCOPED_TABLES drives the collection rename and move UPDATEs (the Technical Design's Rename paragraph depends on it). The VACUUM lists name nexus.chunks, and VACUUM (ANALYZE) on a partitioned parent behaves differently from a plain table. Not named by the RDR table.
td_rows.fallback_form: The same decision per list, over tenant leaves only.

P1.3 should derive it from the walked schema, not replay the history. Not named by the RDR table beyond the added embedding_model and the three typed vector columns.
td_rows.fallback_form: Same, minus embedding_model; LIST-partitioned by tenant_id.
